home.title: Vime: an offline Japanese keyboard
home.description: Vime is a fully offline Japanese keyboard for iOS with romaji and 12-key kana layouts. Conversion, correction and suggestions all run on your device.
home.tagline: A fully offline Japanese keyboard for iOS
home.intro: Type with a romaji QWERTY layout or a 12-key kana pad, and switch between hiragana, katakana and English at any time. Kana-kanji conversion is built on the [azooKey](https://github.com/azooKey/AzooKeyKanaKanjiConverter) dictionary engine; a small on-device Core ML language model reranks the candidates and suggests the next word after you commit text.

points.title: Your typing stays on your device
points.text: Conversion, correction, learning and suggestions all run locally. Vime contains no networking code.

points.title: Two Japanese layouts
points.text: Full romaji QWERTY, or a 12-key kana pad with flick and toggle input.

points.title: Candidates that read the context
points.text: A local language model ranks candidates using the preceding text, then suggests the next word.

groups.title: Input
items: **Two Japanese layouts**: full romaji QWERTY, or a 12-key kana pad. On the pad, tap for the あ-column kana and flick left, up, right or down for the others; tapping the same key repeatedly cycles through its kana (toggle input).
**Instant kana draft**: kana appear as you type, and unfinished consonants stay as romaji. Conversion and predictions update in the background without blocking input.
**Direct English input** with a one-tap Japanese/English switch; the number page can be a 3×3 pad or a full row layout.
Move the cursor by dragging after a long press on the space bar, or by swiping across the keys; swipe up on a letter to enter its symbol.

groups.title: Conversion and candidates
items: **Whole-sentence and segmented conversion**: expand the candidates and use `−` / `+` to resize the first segment. After you confirm it, the rest keeps converting.
**Smart ranking**: azooKey generates the candidates, and a local language model (INT8, CPU only) rescores them using the preceding text. Plain dictionary ranking is also available.
**Next-word suggestions**: after you commit text, the idle candidate bar shows likely next words; tap one to keep going.
**Correction candidates**: neighboring-key slips, similar sounds and a limited set of misreadings appear as candidates and are only applied when you pick them.
**Format candidates**: half-width katakana (ｶﾞｯｺｳ) and full-width alphanumerics (ａｂｃ１２３).

groups.title: Productivity
items: **User dictionary and phrase shortcuts**, with JSON import and export (up to 1,024 entries).
**Clipboard suggestions** (off by default): newly copied text appears in the candidate bar, and the last 24 hours of history stay on the device only.
**Calculator on the number page**: typing `1+1` offers `2` and `1+1=2`.
**Auto-paired brackets**: `()`, `（）`, `「」` and more, with the cursor placed between them.
Categorized symbols, emoji and kaomoji; the symbol column on the number page is customizable.

groups.title: Personalization
items: Built-in themes plus custom skins with your own background, key images and colors, shared as `.vimeskin` files.
Drag to resize the keyboard; key sounds and continuously adjustable haptic strength.
Learns your word choices on the device, and the learning can be cleared at any time.

groups.title: Companion app
items: **Three-step setup**: add the keyboard, allow full access and switch to Vime; once done, the app opens the typing practice.
**Typing practice**: type a sample sentence, and correct characters turn blue as you go.
A status card in Settings shows whether the keyboard is working, which model version is loaded and how much it has learned.
The interface is available in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, English and Korean.

setup: Install Vime, open the app and follow the setup on the home screen, or add Vime manually under Settings → General → Keyboard → Keyboards → Add New Keyboard.
In any text field, long-press the globe key and choose “Vime 日本語”.
Basic offline typing works without Allow Full Access. Key sounds and haptics, settings shared between the app and keyboard, custom skins, user dictionary sync and clipboard suggestions require it.
privacy: Conversion, correction, ranking, suggestions and learning all happen on the device. Vime contains no networking code and never uploads what you type or copy.
Learning data, the user dictionary and skins live in the shared App Group container; clipboard history is excluded from system backups.
No account, no ads, no tracking.
home.open_text: Vime is released under GPL-3.0-or-later. The source code, issue tracker and development docs are on GitHub. Kana-kanji conversion uses [AzooKeyKanaKanjiConverter](https://github.com/azooKey/AzooKeyKanaKanjiConverter), tokenization uses [SentencePiece](https://github.com/google/sentencepiece), and the bundled Japanese model is [VimeML](https://github.com/Voltline/VimeML).

rhythm: Monday to Tuesday: changes are merged into the development branch.
**Tuesday 19:00 UTC** (Wednesday 03:00 in Beijing): new changes on the development branch become this week's beta and are uploaded to TestFlight.
Wednesday to Friday: the TestFlight build is checked and the release notes are written.
**Saturday 02:00 UTC** (10:00 in Beijing): the build is submitted for App Store review and released automatically once approved.
